title: Critbot profile
description: A profile is the Screen 2 artifact: a lens over the transcript, expressed as faculties (classify/score/annotate/coach/extract), each independently switchable. A rubric library is a valid profile with all faculties on and no skill/MCP bindings — so library.schema.json files normalize into this. See ../../docs/lens-model.md and ../lens/CONTRACT.md.

extends.description: id of a profile/library this composes over (house → team → personal). Resolved against a registry at normalize time.

audience.description: default ear for this lens's emissions

faculties.description: per-faculty switches + config. Anything omitted inherits from `extends`, then from core defaults (classify/score/coach on; annotate/extract off).

classificationTaxonomy.description: rim-defined classify vocabulary; defaults to the core five

scoring.description: rim-defined score dimensions (same shape as library.schema.json)

coachingCues.description: rim-defined coach cues (same shape as library.schema.json)

guidelines.description: the lens's notion of a good crit; carried through from a library

context.description: MCP/context bindings the lens may pull from, e.g. [{ id, source, query }]. Resolved by a ContextProvider at runtime and folded into the perspective (MCP lens, M14).
